name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-aftereffects
title: After Effects MCP Server
description: Drive Adobe After Effects from any MCP client: compositions, layers, animation and rendering.

environmentVariables.name: AFTEREFFECTS_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: macOS only: address a specific copy, e.g. "Adobe After Effects 2025". Default: After Effects by bundle id

environmentVariables.name: AFTEREFFECTS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: AFTEREFFECTS_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for After Effects before reporting that a dialog may be open. Default 120000
